narrative: On the tables. The tables lie open and idle. His hands are off them. The red knot is in the grey light at the far side, unopened. On the tables. From the board, the shut Holinshed with the cat across it. He does not reach. The tables stay as they were. On the tables. He turns his head. The leaf is unchanged. A voice from the stair, not on the page.
